Cookie Policy

Last updated: November 2, 2026

What cookies are

Cookies are small text files that a website can store on your device. Websites use them to remember settings, keep you signed in, or measure and track visits.

Our use of cookies

This website sets no cookies. It also uses no analytics, advertising or other tracking technologies, so there is no cookie banner and nothing for you to accept.

Third-party requests

Some features make requests to other services, and those services may process technical data such as your IP address and browser details:

  • Google Fonts supplies the website's fonts when a page loads.
  • Web3Forms receives what you typed when you submit the demo form, and emails it to us.

These requests are explained in our Privacy Policy. Their providers have their own policies.

Controlling cookies in your browser

You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings, and most browsers let you block third-party requests with extensions. Each browser does this differently, so check its help pages. Because this website sets no cookies, blocking them will not change how it works.

Changes to this policy

If we ever add cookies or tracking, we will update this policy first. The date at the top of this page shows when it last changed.
